panels.prompt: Create a production game comic illustration, panel M03-B01 'The interrupted warning'. Wide landscape 16:9, 2048x1152 if possible. Stylized low-poly faceted 3D military desert city, geometric surfaces, crisp angular silhouettes, warm sandstone and ochre, deep charcoal interior, cinematic amber sunlight with turquoise hologram accent. One continuous scene, no collage. Inside a forward-post command cabin: ARIA, a cyan faceted holographic adult female head and shoulders with short geometric swept hair, is projected above a tactical desk. Beside the projection a small blank warning display has a visibly broken pulse line, while through a broad window the dusty western road curves toward a distant junction. A military binocular set and radio sit on the desk; no enemy count visible. Story: an offline warning sector and an uncertain scout report, urgent but composed. Camera is three-quarter medium-wide, ARIA and broken signal are focal points in the middle 65% width. Keep all important faces and evidence within central 70% width and central 65% height for landscape crops. Lower 22% is simple dark desk surface reserved for externally rendered captions, no baked captions. No words, letters, numbers, logos, UI frames, speech balloons, gore, photorealistic textures or comic halftone. Finished game art consistent with a polished polygonal RTS.

Game comic panel M03-B02 'The junction and the clinic'. Finished stylized low-poly faceted 3D desert military RTS art, wide 16:9 1672x941. Angular geometry, warm sandstone, ochre sunlight, charcoal shadows, clear shapes and cinematic composition. Adult Major Dalia Rahim in tan uniform and tactical vest, dark hair tied back, black wraparound sunglasses and headset, stands at a restored forward-post balcony in the center-right and points toward the road junction in the middle distance. A low clinic with a GREEN medical cross is beyond the road; four tiny civilians walk safely toward it. A modest watchtower and square control post form recognizable landmarks. The road from the west forks toward the defended post and inner town; space beside the road suggests a forward firing position and another closer to the post. No shooting, no explosions, no enemy counts, no victory celebration. Practical briefing mood. Keep Dalia's face and landmarks within central 70 percent width; clear horizon and simple dark foreground parapet in lower 22 percent for external subtitles. One continuous scene; no inset panels, no letters or numbers, no captions or speech balloons, no logos, no photorealism, no halftone. Match polished faceted polygonal strategy-game comic art.

Production game comic illustration M03-B03 'A minute to prepare', one continuous wide 16:9 1672x941 composition. Polished stylized low-poly faceted 3D military RTS with angular geometry, desert ochre and charcoal, cyan accent, golden late-afternoon light. Over-the-shoulder shot behind an anonymous adult commander at a waist-high outdoor tactical table, the commander mostly a foreground silhouette left. In central middle distance two small four-person rifle squads in tan uniforms gather near a completed low sandstone Barracks building. An unarmed olive ground radar vehicle with a small rotating rectangular radar aerial waits beside them. A stack of movable road barriers and a modest watchtower are nearby as visual defense choices. Dusty western convoy road and a junction visible farther back. Tiny cyan ARIA female hologram above the table, clearly a support adviser. Scene communicates limited preparation time and deliberate choices; no timer, no numbers, no shooting, no explosions. Keep important subjects central 70% width, faces above lower caption zone; lower 22% clean dark table foreground for external bilingual captions. No rendered writing, lettering, logos, speech balloons, inset diagrams, decorative frames or halftone. Cinematic, readable and calm under pressure.

Finished game comic insert M03-C01 'The timing matches'. Wide landscape 16:9, 1672x941. Polished stylized low-poly faceted 3D military desert city RTS art, crisp angular geometric surfaces, charcoal and amber, cyan holographic light. Close view of a radio operator's gloved hand and rugged data tablet on a command desk. ARIA is a calm cyan polygonal female holographic face with short geometric swept hair above the tablet. On the tablet, two simple unlabeled horizontal timelines align at the same glowing vertical cyan notch: one convoy departure silhouette and one dark warning-network aerial silhouette, no written timestamps or letters. Through a small distant window, a dusty road and indistinct armored movement, no count revealed, no shooting. This is evidence of suspiciously coordinated timing, not proof of a culprit. Keep the tablet and ARIA within central 65% width and above bottom 23%. Bottom foreground simple dark desk for external bilingual captions. Single continuous scene, no comic border, no text or numbers or speech balloons, no logos, no gore, no photorealism or halftone. A tense radio report illustration that can be shown in the mission archive after combat.
panels.revisionPrompt: Edit this M03-C01 comic illustration with ONE precise change: remove the aircraft/drone silhouette from the lower timeline on the tablet. In that spot show only the dark silhouettes of warning-network aerial towers, with one small dark disconnected signal indicator. This story is about a warning-network outage, not an aerial attack. Preserve ARIA, the gloved hand, tablet framing, aligned cyan timeline markers, background convoy, polygonal low-poly art style, lighting, colors and all other composition. Do not add text, numbers, captions, aircraft, weapons or any new elements elsewhere. Keep landscape 16:9.

panels.prompt: Game comic panel M03-D01 'Take an accurate account'. Wide 16:9, 1672x941 finished stylized low-poly faceted 3D military desert city RTS art. Major Dalia Rahim, adult woman with black hair tied back, black wraparound sunglasses and headset, wearing tan uniform and tactical vest, stands near center holding an unreadable blank report clipboard, expression sober and focused. No celebratory poses, no medals, no bodies, no blood, no casualty claims. Low angular sandstone walls, palm shadows, subdued golden evening lighting with cyan radio light. No text, letters, numbers, speech balloons, logos, framing graphics, photorealism or halftone. Honest restrained aftermath composition suitable for both a clean victory and a costly victory.

Production comic panel M03-D02 'Evidence of advance knowledge'. Wide 16:9 1672x941 polished low-poly faceted 3D military desert RTS art, strong geometric faces, charcoal command-room interior, warm amber light through window and cyan hologram glow. Adult Major Dalia Rahim in tan tactical uniform, black sunglasses, dark tied-back hair and headset stands center-right beside a tactical desk, thoughtfully comparing two recovered paper orders. No suspect portraits, villains, flags, aircraft or accusations: this evidence only suggests that somebody had advance knowledge of the warning-network outage. Through the window the standing forward post and twilight sandstone city are softly visible. Central faces and papers occupy central 70% width and central 65% height, lower 22% simple dark desktop reserved for external English/Persian captions. One continuous image, no inset panels, no speech bubbles, no logos, no decorative frame, no photorealism or halftone. Quiet investigative tension after the defense.

Production game comic panel M03-D03 'The next call'. Wide landscape 16:9 1672x941, polished stylized low-poly faceted 3D military desert RTS art with angular geometry and cinematic amber dusk, teal and charcoal accents. Adult engineer Samira Haddad, medium tan skin, warm expressive face, mustard yellow headscarf, dark charcoal jacket over a teal shirt, stands centrally with a handheld radio, speaking with urgent resolve.
